notes: 修复「点 × 关闭不触发自动拉取/推送」的真凶：Electron 关窗钩子是死结——插件跑在 host 子进程里拿不到 electron.app，且 browser-window-created 事件在插件 apply 时窗口早建好就错过了，closed 回调永不执行，所以 0.3.93 起那条链从未真正触发过。改为前端页面卸载信标：pagehide/beforeunload → navigator.sendBeacon('/config-sync/auto-exit') → 后端新路由 fast 判一次（只读本地 tracking ref、不 git fetch，毫秒级返回，避免插件随 DSH 退出被杀前来不及排队）→ spawnWatcher，watcher 独立存活，DSH 进程全消失后由 post-exit.ps1 执行 pull/push。selftest/clientcheck 加断言防回归。保留 0.3.93/0.3.94/0.3.95 的全部修复。
notesEn: Fix the real cause of 'closing × still does not trigger auto pull/push': the Electron close hook is a dead end — the plugin runs in the host child process with no electron.app, and browser-window-created fired long before plugin apply, so the closed callback never ran and the chain added in 0.3.93 never actually triggered. Replaced with a page-unload beacon: pagehide/beforeunload → navigator.sendBeacon('/config-sync/auto-exit') → a new backend route that checks once in fast mode (local tracking ref only, no git fetch, millisecond return, so the plugin can queue before DSH kills it) → spawnWatcher; the watcher lives independently and post-exit.ps1 runs pull/push after all DSH processes exit. selftest/clientcheck assertions added to prevent regression. Keeps all 0.3.93/0.3.94/0.3.95 fixes.
